narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Nine fives make forty five, and five fives make twenty five, giving forty five point two five rupees.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Look at the point five. It is half a rupee on each pen.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Five halves make two and a half rupees, not a quarter of a rupee.
